name: Bytewarden Password Manager
summary: Open-source password manager for the server you choose. Save, generate, and autofill passwords and passkeys.
description: Save passwords, passkeys, and cards in an end-to-end encrypted vault, and autofill them as you browse. Enter your server's address to log in; Bytewarden works with Bitwarden-compatible servers. Open source under GPLv3, independently maintained by Convex Works, and not affiliated with Bitwarden Inc.
